The speaker finds the laptop's performance unacceptable.

assumptions.text: Technological obsolescence reflects poorly on personal competence or responsibility.
Criticism of someone's possessions implies concern for their well-being.
Public acknowledgment of flaws strengthens social accountability.
Functional inadequacy of personal tools undermines credibility in professional settings.
